mentions.name: APIKulture
mentions.description: A lightweight desktop API client and alternative to Postman, Insomnia, and Bruno. It remembers JSONPath expressions between requests, is built with C++ and wxWidgets, and uses about 40MB of RAM while running fast, compared to roughly 400MB used by the comparable programs.
mentions.problem: Postman and Insomnia became forced-corporate-cloud products that were no longer usable, and Bruno lacked remembering JSONPath expressions between requests, a feature considered fundamental for the author's workflow.
mentions.source_excerpt:
APIKulture. An alternative to Postman/Insomnia/Bruno.

To be honest, I started this because Postman and Insomnia became forced-corporate-cloud not usable for me anymore, and Bruno lacked a feature I considered fundamental for my workflow.

The feature is to remember the JSONPath expressions between requests
